svg.title: Where the PHP fix is observed and where evidence stops
svg.desc: Five evidence rows. The PHP fix, four selected official image digests, five selected derivative image configurations and one derivative layer match are observed. Pulls and running deployments are not measured. Traffic reports show attempted exploitation, not successful compromise or AI attribution.
svg.text: Selected records on 21–22 October · each row is a different kind of observation

g.text: Four supported branches in this episode
Four chosen moving tags match fixed-version digests
Five chosen configs declare fixed PHP; one Drupal layer match
No pull share, deployment count or runtime check
Attempts reported; no confirmed compromise or attacker AI trace

svg.text: These selected artifact counts are not a population rate. Sources and replay in the linked studies.
